Here's your FY25 revenue as a line chart, one series per region across Q1–Q4.

A few things that stand out:

- **East is the clear leader** every quarter, climbing steadily from $1,335K to $1,532K over the year.
- **North, West, and South** follow the same ranking in every quarter (North > West > South), and all three rise consistently quarter over quarter — no dips anywhere.
- **South is the smallest region**, but it's also growing at a solid pace (+15% from Q1 to Q4), roughly in line with the others.

Every region shows sustained upward momentum with no quarter-on-quarter declines, which is a healthy, predictable growth profile.

One caveat worth flagging: the notes you included indicate these are **unaudited management accounts** — recognised on signed contracts only, with one-off project work excluded and FX translated at quarter-end rates. So the figures may be restated after year-end close. Want me to add a total-revenue line, switch to a stacked view, or show quarter-over-quarter growth rates instead?
